reasons.claim: The chain runs in order through four named transmitters to Abu Amr, each linked by a transmission verb.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى، قال حدثنا شعبة، قال أخبرني الوليد بن العيزار

reasons.claim: Abu Amr al-Shaybani is the next link, heard by al-Walid.
Abu Amr's informant is described, not named, so the last link is an unnamed link and is not completed from the house he points to.
The pointing to a house is a description of where the informant lives, not a name and not a separate link.
The informant who related is the one who asked the Prophet, so he is the last link and the Prophet ends the chain.
The stored chain's second branch makes the pointing gesture a link, which is wrong.

reviews.uncertainty_note: The structure is settled, but the unnamed surface could be written as the full description «صاحب، هذه الدار» rather than «صاحب» alone, and a person may wish to rule on a source known only by a description.
